answer: Cross-epoch behaviour fingerprint gate. Each identity must reproduce a hidden behavioural signature chosen from a nebula of prior-epoch traces: a fixed sequence of deterministic micro-tasks whose answers are checked against that identity's own committed history. Continuity across epochs requires the signature to match at an inlet of at least three independent task families. Any identity that fails two consecutive checks is quarantined on a reef of frozen actions, losing all pending rewards and its accumulated reputation weight.
